name: Edge Case — Employee ID is Empty String
goal: Bot correctly handles an empty string as employee_id and shows the error message.
constraints: Employee details fetch returns employee_id as an empty string.

phases.description: Bot attempts to fetch employee details but receives empty employee_id.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays only: 'There is some issue in fetching your details.' and marks task as done.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
